verdict.rationale: Recurly's docs say you can export detailed reports covering customer records, subscriptions, invoices, transactions and revenue recognition, which covers the core data-export part of the story. Payment-method portability rests on a single older community comment saying the Recurly gateway includes credit card portability, with no first-party documentation of the outbound process. Missing for 10: explicit export of usage records, first-party documentation of porting stored payment methods to another provider, and hands-on corroboration of a full exit migration.
